title: BookOne shared UI/UX acceptance workbook
scope: Additive UX companion; mappings compose business journeys and do not create canonical business acceptance.

rules.title: Meaningful outcomes
rules.expectation: Every meaningful write exposes pending and conclusive success/refusal; success identifies the resulting record or saved state and agrees with persisted readback.

rules.title: Safe pending lifecycle
rules.expectation: Use existing shared Button/useFormStatus or withFormPending; all paths clear pending. Search, GET filters and Cancel do not trigger a write overlay. A timeout clearing the overlay is not a failed transaction.

rules.title: Ambiguous submission
rules.expectation: When commit outcome is unknown, inspect persisted document/allocation/journal first; offer safe status recovery rather than unconditional retry. Repeated submission must not duplicate a business event.

rules.title: Retain work after refusal
rules.expectation: Client validation and server rejection preserve all recoverable submitted fields, line identifiers/order, dates, notes, tax, discounts and selections; correct only the offending field and submit once.

rules.title: Actionable validation
rules.expectation: Name the invalid field/row, state the constraint and correction in text; associate errors with inputs; provide an accessible way to locate multiple errors without relying on colour.

rules.title: Review financial actions
rules.expectation: Financial submissions provide review/correction or a supported reversible mechanism appropriate to the action; destructive confirmations identify object/count/consequence and cancel without writes.

rules.title: Draft continuity
rules.expectation: Save/reopen/edit preserves stored draft facts and displayed arithmetic. Navigation or rerender must not silently reset typed dates/notes/discounts; unsaved-work handling must be explicit for the affected form.

rules.title: Atomic source changes
rules.expectation: Changing source A→B replaces source party, ancestry, lines, prices, discounts, remaining quantities and totals coherently; late async responses cannot restore A over B. No mixing of unrelated source data.

rules.title: Historical source facts
rules.expectation: Linked return rows use source price/discount/tax and locked identity as required by the business contract, including added/split rows. Current catalogue settings must not silently replace historical facts.

rules.title: Consistent financial representation
rules.expectation: Visible line/header/tax/adjustment components reconcile to preview, stored document, print and journal. Labels distinguish gross, line-net, header discount, supply, VAT and total; residual adjustments stay explicit.

rules.title: State and scope clarity
rules.expectation: Clearly distinguish draft/posted/partial/paid/returned/voided and current/as-of balances; display applicable company/domain/date/location/currency so operators can interpret the amount.

rules.title: Accessible contextual help
rules.expectation: Explain unfamiliar business terms and consequences. Essential instructions and errors remain available outside tooltips; help is reachable by keyboard/touch. Hover/focus content is dismissible, hoverable and persistent as applicable.

rules.title: Labels and plain language
rules.expectation: Use persistent descriptive labels and outcome-specific actions; placeholders do not replace labels. Keep existing approved entity-specific language; explain technical/accounting terms when needed.

rules.title: Distinguish empty and failed
rules.expectation: Differentiate first-use empty, no matches, permission limitation, loading and load error; provide appropriate next action and do not disguise an error as no records.

rules.title: Search and filter integrity
rules.expectation: Preserve existing list guide: search includes number/name or SKU; date filter boundaries and selected scope are visible; changing search/date/sort resets invalid pagination and never mutates business data.

rules.title: Accessible list operations
rules.expectation: Actions resolve the intended row on every page; portals remain visible inside viewport; sort state, count and pagination are understandable; keyboard users can operate row actions.

rules.title: Product entry continuity
rules.expectation: Keep ProductAddSearch and existing catalogue-specific behaviour; preserve focus, committed rows, detail expansion and unique line identities. Exact/debounced auto-add must not create duplicates or discard inputs.

rules.title: Dates and numeric formats
rules.expectation: Typed and picker input, rerender, save and reload preserve the same date/value under declared locale/timezone. Show units/currency and unambiguous formats; rounding follows the financial oracle.

rules.title: Keyboard complete workflows
rules.expectation: All required actions operate by keyboard with logical order and visible focus; there is no keyboard trap. Modal containment is intentional and dismissal restores a sensible focus position.

rules.title: Names roles and states
rules.expectation: Controls expose correct accessible name, role and dynamic state. Icon-only actions have meaningful names; form labels are associated; tables preserve relationships and headers.

rules.title: Accessible status announcements
rules.expectation: Status messages are programmatically available without unnecessary focus movement. Use polite status for routine feedback; reserve interruption for urgent conditions and avoid duplicate announcements.

rules.title: Contrast and non-colour cues
rules.expectation: Meet WCAG AA contrast for applicable text/control states, account for disabled/decorative exceptions, and convey errors/status/selection beyond colour alone.

rules.title: Reflow zoom and text spacing
rules.expectation: At 320 CSS px equivalent width and 200% text enlargement, core content/actions remain usable; spacing overrides do not lose content. Genuine two-dimensional tables may scroll within an accessible region.

rules.title: Targets and unobscured focus
rules.expectation: Meet WCAG2.2 AA 24×24 CSS pixel target or valid spacing/other exception; use existing larger targets where present. Focused controls must not be entirely obscured by sticky UI.

rules.title: Motion and time
rules.expectation: Avoid harmful flashing; preserve meaningful content under reduced motion. Bind timeout/warning/extension requirements where applicable; do not auto-dismiss information the user must act on.
rules.source: 2.2.1,2.2.2,2.3.1; reduced-motion is a product enhancement unless a specific criterion applies

rules.title: Accessible sign-in
rules.expectation: Allow password managers and paste; provide compliant alternatives/assistance for cognitive authentication tests and redundant entry. No automatic credential or legal-agreement handling is granted by this workbook.

rules.title: Tenant and role transitions
rules.expectation: Verify actor/tenant/domain on switch, navigation and saved readback. UI availability matches capabilities; concealment alone does not prove server denial. Never expose foreign data in feedback/help/export.

rules.title: History and export continuity
rules.expectation: UX changes preserve source ancestry, historical prices/tax/dates, issued print/export content, attachments and audit attribution. New layout alone must not rewrite saved documents.

rules.title: Extend existing visual language
rules.expectation: Reuse BookOne CSS variables/classes, shared components and relevant existing guide. Extend a shared primitive compatibly when required; document narrow exceptions. Do not import an alternate palette/framework/reset.

rules.title: Honest progress and responsive interaction
rules.expectation: Provide timely visible feedback for slow tasks; inputs/cancel/scope remain usable as appropriate. Measure task timings against a declared device/network budget; no invented universal response-time release threshold.

rules.title: Evidence over appearance
rules.expectation: Rendered interaction and persisted business effects are required for claimed workflow passes. Screenshots, axe scans, source lint and subjective design scores each have limited scope; missing layers remain explicit.

rules.title: Maintain and audit continuously
rules.expectation: Every UI feature/defect/shared dependency change triggers direct/dependent rule/workflow mapping, versioning, original evidence preservation and exact/adjacent regression review. Exceptions name owner, rationale, mitigation, expiry and retest.
